conf.description: Ivanti ICS admin-access WELF (syslog-kv): mgmt records omit src/proto/op/arg/result/sent/rcvd/agent/duration altogether, so the admin's source IP and the changed-account target are regexed out of msg using the two documented ADM/USR templates rather than left absent.

conf.comment: Ivanti ICS admin-access WELF. type=mgmt records never carry src=, so source.ip is recovered from msg for ADM22668/22671/23452 only (the documented ' from <ip>' templates); other ADM ids with an IP in prose are NOT covered - do not assume source.ip is populated for every admin record. changed-account extraction covers ADM20716's exact template only. Keys are matched by name: the stock WELF key set and order differ by event class.

functions.description: Message body: a Cribl Syslog Source leaves the full line, header included, in _raw and the body in message; anything else carries the body in _raw.

WELF keys by name, not position: the key set and order vary by event class (mgmt lines put proto..rcvd between type and msg; newer vpn lines add sessionID), unquoted values such as ivs may contain spaces, and an empty value stays absent
recover the administrator source IP from the ADM22668/22671/23452 ' from <ip>' message templates - the only place it exists on a mgmt record
recover the target account name from the ADM20716 account-management template
batch every clean 1:1 mapped field in one rename

event.code from the ADM/AUT id; roles to array; ivs/realm/type to ivanti.ics.* customs; regex-recovered source.ip and user.target.name; severity cast; _time (same UTC-fallback caveat as user-access); event.dataset; drop redundant raw fields
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
